paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption_used: Massive activation values across layers under baseline conditions, showing four component signals. The ffn_residual (red solid) and attn_residual (orange dotted) lines rise sharply at layer 5 to approximately 1400, with ffn_residual maintaining values between 1400 and 1600 through layer 20 before declining. The attn_residual closely mirrors ffn_residual but with a one-layer rightward shift. The ffn_output (green dash-dot) exhibits periodic spikes at layers 5, 13, and 22, reaching peak values of approximately 800. The attn_output (blue dashed) remains near zero throughout all layers, with no notable increase at any point in the network. The data indicates that massive activations in the baseline are driven primarily by the feed-forward network residual stream, with attention outputs contributing negligibly.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата илюстрира промените в максималните стойности на активацията по слоеве при базовия модел, като показва четири компонентни сигнала. Оста X, означена като "Layer", представлява слоевете на модела и е линейна, с диапазон от 0 до 22. Етикетите са разположени с интервал от 5 единици (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y, означена като "Max Activation Value", е линейна и показва стойности от 0 до 1600, с етикети на интервали от 200 (0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000, 1200, 1400, 1600).

Линията "ffn_residual" е червена, плътна и показва рязък спад от стойност 0 при слой 0 до стойност около 1400 при слой 5, след което се поддържа на ниво между 1400 и 1600 до слой 20, след което спада рязко до стойност около 500 при слой 22. Линията "attn_residual" е оранжева, пунктирна и показва сходно поведение като "ffn_residual", но с един слой отместване: стойността расте от 0 при слой 0 до около 1400 при слой 6, се поддържа между 1400 и 1600 до слой 21, след което спада до около 250 при слой 22. Линията "ffn_output" е зелена, с дълги тире, и показва периодични върхове: стойността е 0 до слой 5, където достига пик от около 800, след това спада до 0 при слой 7, отново расте до около 800 при слой 13, спада до 0 при слой 15, и отново достига около 800 при слой 22. Линията "attn_output" е синя, с къси тире, и остава близо до 0 през целия диапазон на слоевете, без да показва значителни върхове или промени.
model_annotations.Chinese: The graph, titled "Massive Activation of baseline," displays the maximum activation values across layers for four distinct components in a neural network under baseline conditions. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22 in integer steps, with no units specified. The y-axis indicates the maximum activation value, scaled from 0 to 1600 in increments of 200. The ffn_residual (red solid line) begins near zero at layer 0, sharply increases to approximately 1400 at layer 5, and remains elevated between 1400 and 1600 until layer 20, after which it declines. The attn_residual (orange dotted line) follows a similar trend but is shifted one layer to the right, rising to about 1400 at layer 6 and maintaining values above 1400 until layer 20 before decreasing. The ffn_output (green dash-dot line) shows periodic spikes at layers 5, 13, and 22, reaching peak values of approximately 800 at each of these layers, with values near zero elsewhere. The attn_output (blue dashed line) remains close to zero across all layers, with no discernible increase at any point.
model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the maximum activation values across layers under baseline conditions for four distinct components in a large language model: `attn_output`, `attn_residual`, `ffn_output`, and `ffn_residual`. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22 on a linear scale, while the y-axis shows the maximum activation value, scaled from 0 to 1600. The `ffn_residual` (red solid line) begins near zero, sharply increases at layer 5 to approximately 1400, and remains elevated between 1400 and 1600 until layer 20 before declining. The `attn_residual` (orange dotted line) follows a similar trend but is shifted one layer to the right, rising at layer 6 to a peak of about 1400 and maintaining high values through layer 21. The `ffn_output` (green dash-dot line) shows periodic spikes, with peaks at layers 5, 13, and 22, reaching maximum values of around 800. In contrast, the `attn_output` (blue dashed line) remains near zero across all layers, with no significant activation observed. This pattern indicates that the dominant source of massive activations in the baseline model is the feed-forward network residual stream, while attention outputs contribute minimally.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt die maximalen Aktivierungswerte über die Schichten unter Baseline-Bedingungen für vier verschiedene Komponenten: attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output und ffn_residual. Die x-Achse repräsentiert die Schicht (Layer) und ist linear skaliert mit einem Wertebereich von 0 bis 22, wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen in Einerschritten angegeben sind. Die y-Achse stellt den maximalen Aktivierungswert dar und ist linear skaliert von 0 bis 1600, mit Beschriftungen in 200-Einheiten-Intervallen. Die Linie für attn_output (blau, gestrichelt) bleibt nahe bei 0 über den gesamten Bereich der x-Achse und zeigt keine signifikanten Anstiege. Die Linie für attn_residual (orange, punktiert) beginnt bei 0 und steigt ab Layer 5 stark an, erreicht bei Layer 5 einen Wert von etwa 1400, bleibt bis Layer 20 zwischen 1400 und 1600 und fällt dann ab. Die Linie für ffn_output (grün, strichpunkt) zeigt periodische Spitzen bei Layer 5, 13 und 22, wobei der Wert bei Layer 5 etwa 800 beträgt, bei Layer 13 etwa 600 und bei Layer 22 etwa 1200. Die Linie für ffn_residual (rot, durchgezogen) steigt ab Layer 5 stark an, erreicht bei Layer 5 einen Wert von etwa 1400, bleibt bis Layer 20 zwischen 1400 und 1600 und fällt dann ab.
